preregistration.arm: Each cached service keeps its exact usable-flow count. Each flow independently draws one rate with replacement from the pooled empirical per-flow rate distribution, then emits 30 i.i.d. Bernoulli bits at that rate.
preregistration.within_flow_truth: i.i.d.; no within-flow dependence is generated
preregistration.comparison: same exact MLE/BIC fit imported from /root/eibo/x3_variant_c_nested_lr.py:fit_nested_models

decision_rule_given_by_request.dead: If this arm also returns Markov favoured for essentially all items, between-flow heterogeneity fully explains the real result and the corroboration is dead.
decision_rule_given_by_request.survives: If this arm returns IID favoured, the control has discriminating power and the corroboration survives.

preregistration.operationalization: essentially all = at least 44/45 of all per-item per-prefix comparisons in the existing k=2..30 scope; k=30 is also reported separately

empirical_rate_distribution.definition: pooled empirical distribution of per-flow one-rates over cached flows with PPI_LEN >= 30

arm.truth: independent Bernoulli bits within every flow; per-flow rate heterogeneity only

decision.plain_statement: dead: the heterogeneous-i.i.d. arm returns Markov favoured for essentially all item-prefix comparisons
